structure.unit: Virginia Disposition Of Unclaimed Property Act
Definitions; Property Abandoned or Assumed Abandoned

law.catch_line: Intangible personal property held by insurance corporation subject to § 55.1-2501
law.text: An insurance corporation holding any other intangible personal property not covered by subsection A of § 55.1-2507 or § 55.1-2509 shall be otherwise subject to § 55.1-2501.
